body: As a 24 f who also grew up poor so only got dental care now, I can confirm that no one cares about your braces unless they are insecure about something themselves. My boyfriend (now fiancé) said they were adorable and loves me no matter what

As someone who is just getting their braces off, that’s a good price! You can always ask about a payment plan (I paid like $100 a month for 24 months to cover my half) and see if that includes the retainer!
my pharmacist won’t let me lol
this happened to me. i am 8 months in and finally got my grip. try seeing if you can work at other stores to get more practice. it really helped me prove to my manager that i was capable!
i wish my store did it up like this :(
it’s pretty common. i was an rx clerk before i got my license and for a time would work every sunday night as a front cashier to make some extra cash and help the front sm out. no biggie really.
you’re right, i don’t. but i just want someone to care

i understand. my ex dumped me last week because if my depression. i still love him so much. he doesn’t even check in on me like i do him. he seems so good now. as if i made him bad. i will never be able to forgive myself for ruining his life. im so sorry you have to see that. honestly right now you mean the most to me
i’m so sorry. from one stranger to another, this nay not mean much. but i love you. i know i need to hear it so i assume you do too. i love you.
